mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), Federal Reserve tightening reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 102.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 103.0), industrial output contraction reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 103.0.
